inputs_and_sources: Total Adobe ARR Q3 FY26 $27.5B (8-K Ex99.1 2026-09-10; 10-Q). Q3 FY26 sub revenue: BP&C $1.905B, C&MP $4.651B (8-K), Digital Experience sub $1.67B (Adobe IR datasheet 2026-09-10). ARR allocated pro rata to annualized Q3 sub revenue (scale 1.049). Creative flagship = C&MP - DX = $2.981B/qtr -> $12.50B ARR. CC enterprise ARR $2.2B FY24 and 15% FY21-24 CAGR (Adobe Investor Meeting 2025-03-12 deck p.64) grown 1.75 yrs -> $2.81B ESTIMATE. Route-to-market donuts (same deck p.92/95, pixel-measured): C&MP enterprise route 45.8% of $3.92B Q1 FY25 (= DX $1.30B + ~$0.50B/qtr CC enterprise, consistent with $2.2B ARR); BP&C enterprise route 18.9%. Express $0.3B and consumer Firefly $0.2B are ESTIMATES (Adobe does not disclose; Firefly ARR 'approaching $300M' Q2 FY26 call incl. enterprise). Individual vs teams split NOT disclosed by Adobe; sensitivity sets individual CC = 40/50/60% of Creative flagship ARR, teams = residual.
